title: The actual coordinate-tower orientations commute with the one-fibre mate
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by $N>0$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme with $N$ invertible. Fix $d\geq0$, a Noetherian scheme $X$, a quasi-compact compactifiable map $g:X\to S$ and a closed section $s:S\to X$ with $s g=1_S$. The ordinary etale derived categories and the section-family maps are those of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-pur-noetherian-section-specialization-arrows]. Assume that the actual extended-Rees deformation $D_sX$ and $L=\mathbf A^1_S$ are Noetherian and that its projection $q:D_sX\to L$ is quasi-compact and compactifiable. Let $e:X\to\mathbf A^d_S$ be separated etale, locally of finite type and quasi-compact, over $g$, and suppose its square of zero centres is Cartesian. Let $v:D_sX\to\operatorname{Tower}_d(L)$ be the actual extended-Rees map of this pair, followed by the standard Rees coordinate isomorphism $x_j=t u_j$ and the inverse fixed tower-to-affine-space isomorphism [lem-trf-section-rees-base-change-etale, def-trf-coordinate-counit-arrows]. Assume the separated etale, locally finite type and quasi-compact properties of $v$, and $v p_{d,L}=q$. Fix the normalized twist transport and projective-line data used to define the ordered tower counits. Write $B_T=A_T(d)[2d]$ in its ordered tensor model [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], $a:L\to S$, and $i_1:S\to L$. Let $o_C:B_S\to s^*\omega_g$ be the pullback of the actual ordered-tower counit adjunct along $s e$, preceded by the inverse section compositor and coefficient-descent comparison, then followed by the counit-normalized etale locality map of $e$. Let $o_F:a^*B_S\to\widetilde s^*\omega_q$ be the same construction for $v$, preceded by the fixed coefficient pullback isomorphism along $a$. Locality and coefficients use [def-trf-section-local-comparison-data, def-trf-coordinate-counit-arrows]. If $\theta:i_1^*(\widetilde s^*\omega_q)\to s^*\omega_g$ is the actual exceptional mate, and $\sigma:i_1^*a^*B_S\xrightarrow{\sim}B_S$ is the canonical section compositor, then $i_1^*(o_F)\,\theta=\sigma\,o_C$. There is no normalized family comparison among the inputs or conclusions. The formula includes $d=0$, empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring.

proof.text: Use the actual extended-Rees map of the Cartesian-centre pair. On the standard pair its coordinates are x_j=t*u_j, and on the fibre at one they are the original ordered coordinates. Functoriality of the Rees maps identifies the actual one-fibre square for e and v.

Transpose base change of the specified coordinate-tower counit, then restrict to the standard zero section. The standard affine-section orientation theorem states exactly the resulting normalization at one in Tate coordinates. The constant coefficient/unit identity transports its final unit maps, and the canonical ordered Tate products and even-shift comparisons express that equality in the ordered coefficient model.

Exceptional fibre/locality coherence for the etale map of centred pairs transfers the standard square to e and its Rees coordinate map v. The locality isomorphisms are the actual counit-normalized sectionLocality maps. Paste the section and inverse-image compositors and use naturality of their coefficient comparisons. This yields i1*(oF) followed by theta equal to the section compositor followed by oC, before introducing any normalized family comparison.

theorem coordinateTowerSection_oneFibre (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S)]
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (g : X ⟶ S) [HasCompactification g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (s : S ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    [IsNoetherian s.ker.deformationSpace]
    [HasCompactification (Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceProj g s)]
    [QuasiCompact (Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceProj g s)]
    (e : X ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) [Etale e] [IsSeparated e]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType e] [QuasiCompact e]
    (w : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S) = g)
    (sq : IsPullback s (𝟙 S) e (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S))
    (v : s.ker.deformationSpace ⟶
      affineTraceTower (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) d)
    [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (hv : v = SectionReesBaseChange.pairMap
      (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) s e (𝟙 S) sq.w ≫
        Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceToAffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ≫
          (affineTraceAffineSpaceIso (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) d).inv)
    (overV : v ≫ affineTraceProjection (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) d =
      Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceProj g s) :
    letI := affineTraceNoetherian S d
    letI := affineTraceNoetherian (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) d
    let eC := e ≫ (affineTraceAffineSpaceIso S d).inv
    let overC : eC ≫ affineTraceProjection S d = g := by
      rw [Category.assoc, (CoordinateCounitArrows.standardSquare S d).w,
        Category.comp_id, w]
    let C := affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d
    let a := AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S
    let hLine := affineTracePullbackInvertible N a hS
    let oC :=
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (s ≫ eC)
        (affineTraceProjection S d) (by rw [Category.assoc, overC, hs])).inv.app C ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (s ≫ eC)).map
        ((affineLinearCoefficientDescent A N hA t S hS d).inv ≫
          CoordinateCounitArrows.towerAdjoint N hN A hA t D S hS d)) ≫
      (SectionLocalDualizingComparisons.sectionLocality A eC (affineTraceProjection S d)
        g overC (s ≫ eC) s rfl).hom
    let oF := (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t a hS d).hom ≫
      (((leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (s.deformationSpaceSection ≫ v)
        (affineTraceProjection (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) d)
        (by rw [Category.assoc, overV];
            exact Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceSection_deformationSpaceProj hs)).inv.app _ ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (s.deformationSpaceSection ≫ v)).map
        ((affineLinearCoefficientDescent A N hA t
          (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) hLine d).inv ≫
          CoordinateCounitArrows.towerAdjoint N hN A hA t D
            (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) hLine d)) ≫
      (SectionLocalDualizingComparisons.sectionLocality A v
        (affineTraceProjection (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) d)
        (Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceProj g s) overV
        (s.deformationSpaceSection ≫ v) s.deformationSpaceSection rfl).hom)
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A (AffineSpace.oneSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S)).map oF ≫
        atOne A g s hs =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (AffineSpace.oneSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S) a
        (AffineSpace.oneSection_comp_over (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S)).hom.app C ≫ oC
